resources.string: Use this phone with an EasyStock server. Scan the code your administrator gave you, or type the server address to log in.
For example stock.example.org or 192.168.1.20:8080. You can paste a join link here too.
This address can’t be read. Type the host, or host:port, without spaces.
Point the camera at the server’s QR code.
%1$s did not answer over HTTPS. You can try an unencrypted connection (HTTP), but only on a network you trust.
This code connects the phone to %1$s. Nothing is sent before you tap Connect.
%1$s uses HTTP: your password and the stock data travel unencrypted. Only continue on a network you trust, such as your home or company network.
Secure connection, certificate checked against the QR code
A phone can join a server only when it is empty: it then gets the server’s data. Export a backup first if you want to keep what is on this phone, then erase it.
This code gives guest access, to look at the stock.
Guest access is turned off on this server.
This server is new: the account you create now is its administrator.
Your other devices will be logged out.
Shown to the administrator, who can turn your guest access into an account.
3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores
The server did not answer. Check the address, and that this phone is on the right network.
This address answers, but it is not an EasyStock server.
This server uses another version of EasyStock. Update the app or the server.
This server needs a newer version of the app. Update EasyStock.
This server is already set up. Ask its administrator for an invitation.
This server is not set up yet. Its administrator must scan the setup code first.
Too many attempts: this account is locked for a while. Try again later.
This account is disabled. Ask the administrator.
This code is not valid on this server.
This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
This code was already used. Ask for a new one.
This server has too many guests right now. Try again later, or ask the administrator.
The server refused these values. Check the fields.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
Your session has ended on the server.
There is no pending promotion any more.
The server had a problem. Try again later.
The connection could not be saved on this phone. Nothing was changed.
The data of this phone could not be erased. Try again.
Give this code to the administrator, so they can find you.
The server can’t be reached: showing what is stored on this phone.
The administrator gave you the %1$s role. Choose a username and a password to finish.
This phone leaves the server: all the data and photos on this phone are erased. They stay on the server.
Your guest account will be deleted on the server, and all the data and photos on this phone are erased.
%1$d changes have not been sent to the server yet.
The server can’t be told. Log out on this phone only? The session then stays valid on the server until an administrator removes the device.
Your session on the server has ended (logged out elsewhere, account disabled or password reset). The data of this phone was erased.
